## What

One paragraph: what changes and why.

## Validation

- [ ] `ruff check src tests` passes
- [ ] `pytest -q` passes (paste the last line)
- [ ] `black-heron --help` runs
- [ ] No API key, local path or client name in the diff
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated if the change is user-visible
- [ ] Lens prompt or rubric changed: self-audit re-run and FP rate noted

## Notes for the reviewer

Anything you could not verify, say so here.
